We have started a new theme in our Sunday talks which is called “Vision 2020: The Well”.
Vision 2020 is the vision that God has given us to be all that He wants His people to be by the year 2020.
As a church, we want every member to be actively growing, actively serving, actively going out and actively doing missions.
The Well is the name of this theme because Jesus said to the woman at the well that whoever drinks from Him will never thirst again (John 4:13-14).

We believe that as members drink of this well, it will provide them with the spiritual strength they need for their lives and also the spiritual vision and desire that they need to be all that God has designed them to be.
Why a Well?
If the theme is called “The Well” we must examine why Jesus would call Himself a well.
First, in Scripture it says that Jesus came down from heaven and became flesh to become a man like us.
Therefore, Jesus can give us what we need by becoming a man who came from heaven, who knew what it was like to be human.
The second reason he is a well is because he is living water.
Living water is what you would find coming out of a well.
It is not stagnant; it keeps flowing.
That is what Jesus is, He is alive, and He gives life.
So, when someone looks at Jesus and wants to know what is in Jesus, He is a well.
Jesus is that well of living water that we need to drink from.
It may surprise us, but Jesus had a long conversation with the Samaritan woman at the well.

There would be other opportunities to have my book published, but this one would come from the people who were reading the book.
It is rare that I get excited about writing, especially for a book.
But something about the way they phrased it, how it was going to be for the people who are reading it and not just for me, I really liked that.
I took the challenge and I got busy.
I didn’t know what I had signed up for, or maybe I did.
I was in the zone, but then it all went to hell.
I wanted the world to see my book.
But when I submitted it, I had so much ego invested in the writing that when the editor told me that he thought that parts of the story were weak, I got mad.
I wanted him to say that he loved it, not that I was trying hard.
My ego stopped me from being a good writer and it cost me a great opportunity.
It is easy to get your ego involved in your work.
In fact, I can guarantee that you are doing it.
It’s not easy to take notes when someone tells us that there are issues with our writing.
We think that if we don’t like someone who doesn’t like us back, that means they don’t like us.
But that isn’t why we should care what they think.
I’m writing because I have something to say, to give, to share, not for them.
They aren’t paying me, and in fact, they might not read this book.
I shouldn’t care what they think.
But sometimes we have a goal.
The goal was to write the whole thing in 10 weeks.

I am Liz and I have been a writer for over 20 years now.
The stories I write tend to be about people that are living a different life than I am or that have been through something that changed their lives.
Sometimes I write about myself, but only when I think there is value in sharing some part of me.
What do I mean by that?
Well, I think everyone has had a problem, a challenge, a mistake, a loss, a change that we can learn from.
If I have learned something that I think will help someone else, then I’ll share it and give them a chance to learn as well.
This blog isn’t for everybody.
There will be people reading who won’t like it.
But if you have an open mind and you think you might like some stories with an interesting take away at the end, then keep reading!
My first featured story was a story that a friend shared with me.
I wrote it up and put a title and a photo on it.
It wasn’t long, just a few paragraphs long.
I wanted to give people a chance to learn from it.
The title was, “A Lesson From My Mother.” The lesson was, “Don’t try to change other people.”
My mother always said that.
She didn’t say it quite like that, but the meaning was the same.
I remember her saying it all the time.
When I was a little girl, she would tell me when she saw me trying to get someone else to do something she way that I was trying to change the other person, which she didn’t want me to do.
As an adult, I see how right she was.

sentences.sentence: It would be easy to think that this is the moment of victory that you've been waiting for after working so hard.
However, that may not be the case.
It is common for founders to be cashflow positive but not yet be making a living wage.
Here’s why.
If you have a service-based business and you don't have any employees and you don’t take a salary, then you are the company.
There are no people taking money out of the company's checking account other than you.
So, at least from the perspective of the balance sheet, if you own 100% of the business then when it is cash flow positive it will probably mean that it is making money.
But from a personal standpoint, when you aren't drawing a salary, that might not mean you are making a living wage.
If you are not making a living wage, then you are not going to be able to stop burning through your savings.
Also, you won't be able to do anything for your family if there is a medical emergency.
You won't be able to pay for your kid to go to school.
In short, you might not be able to support yourself or others.
If you are an employee then you aren’t going to make a living wage unless you work in a good company.
This means that if you are not drawing a salary and working on your startup, then it might not be making you a living wage.
You can't just stop drawing a salary.
When your business is making a living wage you will be more likely to be able to stop burning through your savings, so you will have enough to live on.

The way the salesman presents the product does not really matter.

The sales man must have all the facts straight and present them in a clear, short, interesting way.

But that is different from buying a car based on his personality, as opposed to the fact that he gives me a very good service.
The service, and not the personality of the salesman, matters here.
So, what do you think about this?
Do you think a humorous salesman will make you want to buy his product?

sentences.sentence: Those were difficult days; some of the most difficult days that I ever had in my life.
It was hard not only to get through those days but to even survive them, as a matter of fact.
And yet, I survived those difficult days.
And I was able to do so thanks to one thing: my faith.
There is not a day that goes by where it does not remind me to never take anything for granted and that I should be thankful for everything that I have and am.
That is something that my father taught me growing up.
He was raised Catholic and instilled that in me as well.
It was important to him that my brother and I learn about Jesus, pray, go to church, and do our best to help people, in order to show God our love.
I still believe and practice all of these things and I know that I will be able to continue on.
I can say that because of my faith.
When I lost my mom, I felt that everything was over and that I could not keep going.
But I kept going, and I kept living, and here I am.
And now, more than 20 years later, I am not only still alive but I am also still able to write.
I am doing exactly what I wanted to do since I was a kid.
Faith does not necessarily mean that you go to church every Sunday, or pray before every meal, or read from your Bible every single day.
But having faith means believing in something that gives you hope.
For me, that is religion.
For others, it could be something completely different like their family, their career, a pet, a sport, etc.
